## Biographical Information

(1819-1915)

Master of Clare College, Cambridge.

Atkinson married [Frances Hester Carter Smith](person_71.qmd), sister of CMY's correspondent Ann Carter Smith, on becoming Master of Clare College, Cambridge in 1856 and held that office to his death.
